Name: MONOPOLY Millionaire
Description: A faster Monopoly, played to a million rather than to bankruptcy.

Achievements.Name: Everybody Starts Somewhere
Achievements.Description: Bought your first property.

Achievements.Name: Now You're On Your Way
Achievements.Description: Owned your first monopoly.

Achievements.Name: Climbing Your Way Up The Ladder
Achievements.Description: Built your first set of houses.

Achievements.Name: The View From The Top
Achievements.Description: Built your first set of hotels.

Achievements.Name: High Roller
Achievements.Description: Rolled a double six twice in a row.

Achievements.Name: Rolled To Jail
Achievements.Description: Rolled three doubles in a row and got jailed.

Achievements.Name: Rolled To Freedom
Achievements.Description: Rolled a double and got out of jail.

Achievements.Name: Globe Trotter
Achievements.Description: Landed on every property on the board in the same game.

Achievements.Name: Millionaire!
Achievements.Description: Got 1 million.

Achievements.Name: Double Up!
Achievements.Description: Got 2 million.

Achievements.Name: Property Thief
Achievements.Description: Used a Sly Deal and a Forced Deal in the same game.

Achievements.Name: Deal Breaker
Achievements.Description: Used a Just Say No card to block the opponent from getting a monopoly off of you.

Achievements.Name: No Mercy
Achievements.Description: Responsible for the bankruptcy of another player.

Achievements.Name: Went For Broke
Achievements.Description: Bankrupted yourself out of the game for the first time.

Achievements.Name: Upgraded Lifestyle!
Achievements.Description: Upgraded your mover to the maximum.

Achievements.Name: Greedy!
Achievements.Description: Got a property for less than the price on the board in Auction.

Achievements.Name: Multi-Millionaires!
Achievements.Description: Played a multiplayer game in Pass 'n Play.

Achievements.Name: Time To Collect
Achievements.Description: Collected your first rent payment from any other player.

Achievements.Name: Dashed Hopes
Achievements.Description: Broke another player's Monopoly.

Achievements.Name: No Monopoly
Achievements.Description: Won a game without holding any monopoly.
